minutes_text:
LA VERNE YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Minutes of the Regular Meeting
  March 26, 2024

1. A meeting of the Youth & Family Action Committee was called to order by Chair Rick
  Crosby at 5:03 p.m.

  Executive Board Members present:

  Executive Board
  Rick Crosby, YFAC Chair, Council Member
  Wendy Lau, Mayor Pro Tem
  Greg Palatto, BUSD
  Denise Fisher, Resident
  Don Kendrick, Resident

2. Review of Minutes  Minutes for the February 27, 2024, meeting were
  approved.

3. SRO Report  Student Resource Officer (SRO) Eduardo Burgos shared
  that he and Motor Officer Salas are doing presentations
  at Saturday school that are particularly DUI focused to
  raise awareness about the dangers of driving while
  intoxicated. They have found a variety of resources that
  they are able to utilize while initiating this conversation
  with the students.

4. BUSD Report  The BUSD student liaisons shared recent student
  accomplishments and updates with the group including
  a Washington DC trip for the seniors who were unable to
  attend the 8th grade trip due to the COVID-19 Pandemic.
  The Bonita High School choirs brought home nine awards
  across the different groups at a competition in San Diego
  in March.

5. Teach & Transform Grant  YFAC Chair Crosby and Mark Rodgers from BUSD
  reviewed the applications for the grant and provided the
  larger group an overview. The Executive Board voted to
  approve all six grant submissions for a total of
  approximately $7,000 of the allocated $10,000 for this
  year’s grant. The Board directed staff to move forward
  with awarding the grantees their funds.

6. Public Comment  Robin Carder discussed options for fundraising for the
  Summer Lunch Program. The group also discussed
  honoring the YFAC Student Liaisons at the May 6 City
  Council Meeting.
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes February 27, 2024, page 2

7. Next Meeting  The next YFAC meeting was scheduled for April 23, 2024
  at 5:00pm.

8. Adjournment  The meeting was adjourned at 5:58 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

Erin Beilstein
Senior Management Analyst
